text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that Tamamo Cross looked tired,
I decided to have her rest in the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout this, Trainer.
I'll get plenty of rest and bounce back in no time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hmmm?? Where on earth is this!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... Tama... I've been waiting for you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Is that you, Oguri?
I can't see ya, where're ya at?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Up above.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're huge!?
I mean, what's with that outfit!?
Is that a dinosaur costume!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In pursuit of greater power, I have grown...
Who I am now—yes, I am the Umamusume Monster: Ogurin.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A m-monster? You really...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. If we leave Ogurin unattended,
Tracen Academy's food storage will suffer catastrophic damage!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Nah,
that doesn't seem all that different from before..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President—no, Commander! Operative Special Week has just arrived on site!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Leave the kaiju to me!
I'll take it down in one shot with my Spe-chan Beam!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'beam'?! And seriously,
what kind of completely uninspired name is that...лга?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eat up my food~!
And transform into Spe-chan Man!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fighting this battle on your own, but...
We're counting on you, Trooper Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Are you kiddin' me!
I can't even keep up with the punchlines anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I just let you clown around like that without a comeback,
it'd bring shame to my Naniwa blood!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If that's how they wanna play it, then so will I!
Uoooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Gigantic Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Take a good look!
I got this huge through sheer guts and willpower~!!

text_block_list.name: Gigantic Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about monsters anymore!
I'm all grown up now~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ――Hah! I-It was a dream, huh. What a crazy dream that was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Though well, I managed to hit back with a joke at the end, and getting my dream fulfilled even for a second felt great!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Tamamo Cross was able to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
You seem to be in a bit of a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you... Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have enough hands to call out all the nonsense, here's what you need!
The "Fully Automated Straight-Man Robot"~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Flip the switch, and behold—
It spins at high speed, dishing out endless straight-man chops like a thousand-armed Kannon~!

text_block_list.name: Fully Automatic Straight-Man Robot
text_block_list.text:
Why you little—!
No way, no way, no way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you're just slapping the back of your hand really fast!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
You got me there.

text_block_list.name: Fully Automatic Straight-Man Robot
text_block_list.text:
Why you little—!
No way, no way, no way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I told you to cut it out with that robot!!
...Wait, i-it was a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Guess it's 'cause I couldn't call 'em out properly, but I just don't feel satisfied...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Tamamo Cross wasn't able
to shake off much of her fatigue.
